name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-styled-sky
title: Super Mario World Styled Sky
description: In my time on this site, I have seen many unique interpretations of Vanilla-esque Sky tilesets for custom overworlds. I decided to take my own spin on this concept, so I combined ideas from a wide variety of tilesets I've seen into one "Choconilla" tileset. This tileset includes tiles for clouds over water, casting a shadow on water, and on a transparent background. The latter can be used to cover cutoffs (examples shown in the BPS) or to implement a layer 3 / gradient background. I've also included larger cloud shapes for extra variety and customization. 4 palettes are included, with custom palette animations in the BPS. Credit is greatly appreciated, but not required.
